pairs.target: zhǎngguì bǎ miáo zhǐ jǔ dào chuāngqián , zhǐ shàng de shuǐzì tòuchū yìquān dànhuáng .
pairs.english: The proprietor raised the tracing to the window; a water stain on the paper showed through as a pale yellow ring.
pairs.hanzi: 掌柜把描纸举到窗前，纸上的水渍透出一圈淡黄。

pairs.target: " zhège búshì wǒ de . "
pairs.english: “This isn't mine.”
pairs.hanzi: “这个不是我的。”

pairs.target: nài lěi yě còu guòqù , kàn le yíhuìer , shuō nà shì qùnián liúxià de .
pairs.english: Nerai leaned closer too, looked a while, and said that had been left last year.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾也凑过去，看了一会儿，说那是去年留下的。

pairs.target: zhǎngguìde jiānbǎng sōng xiàlái , què hái méi fàngshǒu .
pairs.english: The shoulders of the proprietor relaxed, yet he had not let go.
pairs.hanzi: 掌柜的肩膀松下来，却还没放手。

pairs.target: tā wèn tā néng bunéng liú yìzhāng chāoběn , gěi nàxiē lái wènlù de rén kàn .
pairs.english: He asked her whether she could leave a copy for those people coming to ask directions to look at.
pairs.hanzi: 他问她能不能留一张抄本，给那些来问路的人看。

pairs.target: " shàngmiàn xiě zhe nǎ tiān zǒuguò , tāmen yě wèibì kàn . "
pairs.english: “Even if it says what day the route was walked, they may not look.”
pairs.hanzi: “上面写着哪天走过，他们也未必看。”

pairs.target: tā zhǐzhe nà dào duànxiàn , wèn tā zhǔnbèi zěnme shuō zhè yì jié .
pairs.english: Pointing at that broken line, she asked how he meant to describe this stretch.
pairs.hanzi: 她指着那道断线，问他准备怎么说这一截。

pairs.target: zhǎngguì méiyǒu lìkè dá , ménwài què yǒurén tì tā hǎn qǐlái .
pairs.english: The proprietor didn't answer at once, but someone outside the door called out for him.
pairs.hanzi: 掌柜没有立刻答，门外却有人替他喊起来。

pairs.target: " diē , tāmen yòu bǎ chuánqián jiā le ! "
pairs.english: “Dad, they have raised the boat fare again!”
pairs.hanzi: “爹，他们又把船钱加了！”

pairs.target: yígè gūniáng bào zhe bùbāo jìnlái , hànshī de tóufa niánzài éjiǎo .
pairs.english: A girl came in holding a cloth bundle, her sweat-damp hair stuck to her temples.
pairs.hanzi: 一个姑娘抱着布包进来，汗湿的头发黏在额角。

pairs.target: tā bǎ bāo wǎng dèng shàng yì gē , cái kànjiàn zhuōbiān háiyǒu rén .
pairs.english: She set the bundle on a stool before noticing there were other people beside the table.
pairs.hanzi: 她把包往凳上一搁，才看见桌边还有人。

pairs.target: zhǎngguì jiào tā màndiǎn shuō , bié yí jìnmén jiù gēn rén chǎojià .
pairs.english: The proprietor told her to speak more slowly, instead of immediately quarrelling with people as soon as she came in.
pairs.hanzi: 掌柜叫她慢点说，别一进门就跟人吵架。

pairs.target: " wǒ zài mǎtóu yǐjīng chǎoguò le . "
pairs.english: “I already had an argument at the landing.”
pairs.hanzi: “我在码头已经吵过了。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎnxiē xiào chūlái , gǎnjǐn dītóu kàn bāo dài .
pairs.english: Tavi almost laughed, then hurriedly looked down at the bag strap.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维险些笑出来，赶紧低头看包带。

pairs.target: gūniáng shuō chuánjiā yào duō shōuqián , yīnwèi huíchéng méiyǒu huò , děikōng zhe chuán chēng huílái .
pairs.english: The girl said the boatman wanted to charge more because there was no cargo on the return trip and he had to pole an empty boat back.
pairs.hanzi: 姑娘说船家要多收钱，因为回程没有货，得空着船撑回来。

pairs.target: zhǎngguì shuō yǐjīng fù guò , gūniáng biàn cóng bāo lǐ fān chū yìzhāng zhòu zhǐ , àn zài tā de shǒubiān .
pairs.english: The proprietor said he'd already paid, so the girl pulled a crumpled sheet from the bundle and pressed it beside his hand.
pairs.hanzi: 掌柜说已经付过，姑娘便从包里翻出一张皱纸，按在他的手边。

pairs.target: " nǐ zhǐ fù le dānchéng de qián . "
pairs.english: “You only paid the fare for one way.”
pairs.hanzi: “你只付了单程的钱。”

pairs.target: zhǐ jiǎo pèngshàng miáo zhǐ , zhǎngguì máng bǎ liǎngzhāng fēnkāi , jìng xiàng pà chuánqián huì gēnzhe shènguòqù .
pairs.english: The corner touched the tracing; the proprietor hurriedly separated the two sheets, almost as if afraid the boat fare might seep across too.
pairs.hanzi: 纸角碰上描纸，掌柜忙把两张分开，竟像怕船钱会跟着渗过去。

pairs.target: nài lěi chèn zhè kòngdāng shōu hǎo zìjǐ de zhǐ , kǔn shàng xìshéng .
pairs.english: Nerai took the opportunity to put away her own papers and tie them with thin cord.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾趁这空当收好自己的纸，捆上细绳。

pairs.target: gūniáng zhè cái wèn tā shìbushì nàge huà lù de rén .
pairs.english: Only then the girl asked her: was she that person who drew routes?
pairs.hanzi: 姑娘这才问她是不是那个画路的人。

pairs.target: nài lěi shuō suànshì , gūniáng jiù wèn tā , rào shān de jiù lù hái zài bu zài .
pairs.english: Nerai said more or less, and the girl asked her whether the old road around the mountain still existed.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾说算是，姑娘就问她，绕山的旧路还在不在。

pairs.target: tā diē búràng zǒu , shuō nìngkě duōhuāqián , yě bié cóng nàbiān yùn .
pairs.english: Her father would not let her use it, saying he would rather spend more money than transport goods that way.
pairs.hanzi: 她爹不让走，说宁可多花钱，也别从那边运。

pairs.target: zhǎngguì tái yǎnkàn tā , méi chū shēng .
pairs.english: The proprietor looked up at her without a word.
pairs.hanzi: 掌柜抬眼看她，没出声。

pairs.target: " zǒu nàtiáo lù de rén , nǐ wèn guò ma ? "
pairs.english: “Have you asked anyone who uses that road?”
pairs.hanzi: “走那条路的人，你问过吗？”

pairs.target: gūniáng shuō wèn guò , sòng yán de shuō néng zǒu , tā diē quèshuō sòng yán de jiānshàng yòu méi bèizhe tājiā de bōlí .
pairs.english: The girl said she had; the salt carrier said it was passable, but her father said the salt carrier wasn't carrying their glass on his shoulders.
pairs.hanzi: 姑娘说问过，送盐的说能走，她爹却说送盐的肩上又没背着他家的玻璃。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kàn le kàn dèng shàng de bāo , zhōngyú míngbái tā wèihé jìnmén shí bào de nàme jǐn .
pairs.english: Tavi looked at the bundle on the stool and finally understood why she had held it so tightly coming in.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看了看凳上的包，终于明白她为何进门时抱得那么紧。

pairs.target: gūniáng xiānkāi yìjiǎo , lǐmiàn liǎngzhī xìjǐng píng gé zhe hòuhòude bù , píngkǒu yìngzhe chuāng guāng .
pairs.english: The girl lifted one corner; inside, two narrow-necked bottles were separated by thick cloth, their mouths reflecting light from the window.
pairs.hanzi: 姑娘掀开一角，里面两只细颈瓶隔着厚厚的布，瓶口映着窗光。

pairs.target: " yàoshi bànlù shuāi le , wǒ yòu děi tīng tā shuō yígèyuè . "
pairs.english: “If they break halfway, I will have to listen to him talk about it for another month.”
pairs.hanzi: “要是半路摔了，我又得听他说一个月。”

pairs.target: " yígèyuè tàiduǎn . "
pairs.english: “A month is too short.”
pairs.hanzi: “一个月太短。”

pairs.target: zhǎngguì shuōwán , zìjǐ xiān xiào le , shēnshǒu bǎ bāo jiǎo gài huíqù .
pairs.english: Having said that, the proprietor himself laughed first and reached to fold the bundle corner back over.
pairs.hanzi: 掌柜说完，自己先笑了，伸手把包角盖回去。

pairs.target: nài lěi méiyǒu gěi tāmen tiāo lù , zhī wèn kěbukěyǐ jiè dèngzǐ fàng bāo .
pairs.english: Nerai didn't choose a route for them, only asked whether she could borrow the stool for her bag.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾没有给他们挑路，只问可不可以借凳子放包。

pairs.target: gūniáng téngchū dìfāng , tā biàn jiěkāi jiāndài , chóngxīn bǎ zhǐjuǎn zhuāng wěn .
pairs.english: The girl made room, so she undid the shoulder strap and securely settled the paper roll again.
pairs.hanzi: 姑娘腾出地方，她便解开肩带，重新把纸卷装稳。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàn zài ménbiān děng , wàimiàn de chēlún shēngyā guò le fùnǚliǎ hòulái dehuà .
pairs.english: Tavi waited standing by the door; the sound of cart wheels outside drowned out the subsequent conversation between father and daughter.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维站在门边等，外面的车轮声压过了父女俩后来的话。

pairs.target: chūménshí , zhǎngguì zhuīshànglái , hái xiǎng shuō chāoběn de shì .
pairs.english: As they left, the proprietor caught up, still wanting to discuss the matter of the copy.
pairs.hanzi: 出门时，掌柜追上来，还想说抄本的事。

pairs.target: nài lěi shuō xiàhuí zuòxià lái lìng tán , jīntiān xiān bǎ yuántú názǒu .
pairs.english: Nerai said they could sit down and discuss it separately next time; today she would take the originals away first.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾说下回坐下来另谈，今天先把原图拿走。

pairs.target: zǒu dào jiējiǎo , tā hūrán tíngzhù , dītóu dīng zhe gāng bǔ hǎo de xié .
pairs.english: At the street corner she suddenly stopped and stared down at the shoe she had just mended.
pairs.hanzi: 走到街角，她忽然停住，低头盯着刚补好的鞋。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǐwéi yòu jìn le shā , zhèngyào tì tā ná bāo , tā què táiqǐ tóu .
pairs.english: Tavi thought sand had got in again and was about to take her bag, but she lifted her head.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维以为又进了沙，正要替她拿包，她却抬起头。

pairs.target: " wǒ wàng le gēn tā shuō qiáoxià nà dào lán . "
pairs.english: “I forgot to tell him about the railing under the bridge.”
pairs.hanzi: “我忘了跟他说桥下那道栏。”

pairs.target: tā wàngwàng láilù , chángcháng tànqì , yòu zhé le huíqù .
pairs.english: She looked back the way they'd come, sighed deeply, and turned back again.
pairs.hanzi: 她望望来路，长长叹气，又折了回去。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gēnshàngqù , zhèhuí zhōngyú méi néng rěnzhù xiào .
pairs.english: Tavi followed, and this time finally couldn't hold back his laughter.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维跟上去，这回终于没能忍住笑。
